Delta_l = h_S,l - h_O,l at the name's last token from clean S and O forwards, per reader; J++ part = x0_necessity.fit(layer l's letter-token J++ atoms, Delta_l, 25, signed); random part = statement_positions.random_subspace_part(Delta_l, its share, X0's random basis seed 888 + l). Shares per stratum (fact-first, fact-after; 'all' beside) with 95% cluster-bootstrap intervals over the original bridge entity (10,000 resamples, seed 0; every arm and both readers on the same draws). (i): rise = S_K(whole_bL) - S_K(whole_1L) on fact-after, clause at >= 0.30; fact-first |S_K(whole_bL) - S_M(whole_bL)| <= 0.10 (the recall under the same arm); 'the slice explanation' iff both; Q51.7 (i) reads the rise clause. An undefined extra loss (no switch under whole_bL) holds no clause ("can't tell"). (iii): S_K(whole_bL) on fact-after < 0.50 -> 'the link is made away from the bridge token' and the window read is reported (S_K(window) beside S_K(whole_bL) on the same 50 passages; window = the patch token and both bridges' fact sentences, O's and S's, in the K passage, set to S's states at blocks 0..L); else it stays in the files, unreported.
